title: tinospora dissitiflora
intro: Tinospora dissitiflora, commonly known as Guduchi or Amrita, is a plant species that belongs to the family Menispermaceae. It is a woody climber found in the tropical forests of India and Southeast Asia, used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The health benefits of Tinospora dissitiflora include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory properties, which help to boost the immune system and reduce oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-diabetic, anti-cancer, and anti-viral activities.
